page.layout: One blank leaf on the left, with handwriting only (manuscript pencil ownership note and shelfmark-style annotation). Right edge shows the neighbouring page (part of a printed title page) and is not transcribed.
page.notes: No printed text on this leaf. The pencil annotations are handwriting, not print, and are excluded: "Martius Friedrich Wendelin" (top, with a blue pencil stroke below the name) and "[Contemplationum physicarum sectiones 3]" (below, in brackets). The right-hand strip shows the edge of the neighbouring printed title page (fragments such as "PHY..." and "NON...", "MARCO..."), which is outside this page and not transcribed. Scan also shows the page edge and a glass-like object at the left, not text.
